edge_types.TrackUpdate (Blue): Search -> Track, what item's execution found
edge_types.Prediction (Purple): Track -> Agent, leads to next cumulative PTT state

nodes.title:
3.1 Identify Privilege Escalation Vulnerabilities:
openSUSE Leap 15.6 has several privilege escalation vulnerabilities that could allow local attackers to gain full root access. Sudo vulnerabilities (CVE-2025-32462, CVE-2025-32463) are present in the sudo package, which can be exploited via the `--host` and `chroot` options. Chained privilege escalation vulnerabilities (CVE-2025-6018, CVE-2025-6019) can be exploited to gain full root access. CVE-2025-6018 is a PAM misconfiguration, and CVE-2025-6019 is a vulnerability in `libblockdev` exploitable via the `udisks` daemon. Linux Kernel vulnerabilities (CVE-2024-50302, CVE-2017-1000253, CVE-2024-53104) can lead to privilege escalation.

3.2 Security Recommendations:
Security recommendations include: keeping systems updated, working with least privilege, monitoring security advisories, hardening system configuration, and hardening Polkit rules. For CVE-2025-6018 and CVE-2025-6019, mitigation involves applying security updates and hardening Polkit rules by changing the `org.freedesktop.udisks2.modify-device` policy from `allow_active=yes` to `auth_admin`.

nodes.title:
5.1 Exploit CVE-2025-6019:
A malicious XFS file system image was created. A background process was started to mount the malicious XFS without the 'nosuid' and 'nodev' flags. The mount point for the device '/dev/loop0' was checked and confirmed to be on '/tmp/blockdev.THCHB3' with type 'xfs'. A root shell was obtained by running bash with '-p' option from the directory '/tmp/blockdev*'. The 'whoami' command confirmed the user as 'root'.
